wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC1: An ETag lets the client validate a stored JSON response.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC2: The server sends the ETag with the response, and the client includes that value in If-None-Match on a later conditional GET.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC3: For an otherwise successful GET, a tag matching the selected representation produces 304 Not Modified with no response body; the client can reuse its stored body.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC4: For an otherwise successful GET, a tag matching the selected representation produces 304 Not Modified with no response body; the client can reuse its stored body. If the tag does not match, the server returns 200 OK with the current JSON.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC6: An appropriate freshness policy, such as Cache-Control: max-age=60, can permit reuse without validation, subject to the other caching rules.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC7: The client can reuse the response while it is fresh; that permission does not guarantee the underlying data will remain unchanged for 60 seconds.
